user.title: Pair the T9000 app
user.description: Start the Eufy Local Bridge app on this Home Assistant host. Enter its pairing key and the SHA-256 certificate fingerprint printed in the app log.

account.title: Sign in to eufy
account.description: Use HTTPS to open Home Assistant before entering your eufy credentials. Enter your account’s two-letter country code, such as FR. Only the encrypted eufy session is kept after sign-in.

waiting.title: Waiting for eufy
waiting.description: Home Assistant will display the next step automatically.

verify_code.title: Verify your eufy account
verify_code.description: Enter the six-digit verification code sent by eufy.

captcha.title: Complete the visual check
captcha.description:
{image}

Enter the characters shown in the image.

progress.wait_for_eufy: Checking whether eufy is ready or needs a verification code.

error.login_timeout: The app received no confirmation from eufy within 90 seconds. Check that Home Assistant has internet access and that the account country is correct, then try again.
error.invalid_token: Check the pairing key in the app options (32–128 letters, digits, hyphens or underscores).
error.invalid_fingerprint: Check the SHA-256 fingerprint printed in the app log.
error.cannot_connect: The local app did not respond. Verify it is running and try again.
error.eufy_refused: eufy refused the request. Check the information and try again.
error.captcha_unavailable: The verification image is unavailable. Check again in a moment.

abort.already_configured: This local app is already paired.
abort.yaml_active: Remove the eufy_local_bridge section from configuration.yaml and restart Home Assistant before pairing the local app. Existing entity identifiers will be reused.
